summary: Copies a camera/viewport configuration struct from the source definition object (a2) into the destination object: string pointer copy, 3-vector and direct field copies, paired float copies via small field getters, a squared field, and an optional buffer copy. Unconditional, returns the destination pointer.

local_names.v9: second output of the paired field getters

Destination this+136 (0x88) is copied from source +136, and this+140 (0x8C) receives the square of the source value at +136.
Destination this+164/168 (0xA4/0xA8) are copied directly from source +164/+168.
BufferAllocCopy(this + 176, a2 + 176) allocates and copies the optional buffer data region.
